description: List companies (sub-accounts) under a CRM agency with optional search and pagination.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

name: crm_list_companies
